channel.title: The Catholic Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Catholic Review (catholicreview.org)

item.title: Two major medical groups back limits on gender transition procedures for minors
item.description: Two major medical groups have backed limitations on certain types of medical or surgical gender reassignment procedures for minors who identify as transgender.

item.title: Peruvians wait for potential papal visit with anticipation and joy
item.description: Peruvians reacted with a mix of joy and anticipation after Church leaders said there is an "80 percent chance" Pope Leo XIV will visit Peru later this year, likely between November and early December.

item.title: Sister Thea Bowman’s sainthood moving forward to Vatican review
item.description: Servant of God Thea Bowman's canonization cause is moving ahead, with a Mass and ceremony marking the closure of the cause's diocesan phase to be held Feb. 9 at the Cathedral of St. Peter the Apostle in Jackson, Miss.

item.title: Historic restoration to begin at Bethlehem’s Church of the Nativity Grotto After 600 years
item.description: Restoration is set to begin at the grotto of the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem for the first time in 600 years.

item.title: New musical on life of St. Bernadette, Lourdes visionary, begins US tour in Chicago
item.description: Following a successful tour in Europe, a newly developed English version of a French musical about Bernadette Soubirous will open in Chicago Feb. 19 before touring nationwide.

item.title: As Lent approaches, Catholics urged to leave ‘hesitation at the door’ and visit Holy Land
item.description: Franciscan Father Francesco Ielpo, custos of the Holy Land, urged pilgrims to return not only as an opportunity to be where Christ was, but also as a sign of solidarity with Christians in the area whose livelihoods depend on pilgrims.

item.title: All sin is personal but all sin is social
item.description: All sin is social sin because all sin implicates all persons in a given community. This season of Lent is the time for Catholic Christians to demonstrate to the world that reconciliation can only come through repentance -- not of the "nation's" sins, but of our own.

item.title: New book aims to help women find fruitfulness amid struggles with infertility
item.description: Leigh Fitzpatrick Snead wanted to write the book she wished she had as a young woman struggling with infertility.

item.title: A Quaker, Bavarian monk and Catholic king: Exploring Catholic history in Pennsylvania, New York and New Jersey
item.description: In this continuing series on the origins of Catholicism in the 50 states, the Catholic history of the mid-Atlantic offers a particularly revealing case. In New York, Pennsylvania and New Jersey, Catholic life took shape unevenly, shaped as much by law and political culture as by migration and missionary effort.

item.title: Dear Fans of Winter…
item.description: Dear People Who Love Winter, Just checking in here. See all that ice and snow? Yeah, that snowcrete that is our permanent backdrop now?
